title: Yellowstone: The World’s First National Park
summary: Дэлхийн анхны үндэсний цэцэрлэгт хүрээлэн Йеллоустоуны гейзер, зэрлэг амьтад.

questions.prompt: What was special about Yellowstone when it was established in 1872?
options: It was the world’s first national park
It was the largest park in the world
It had the world’s only active volcano
questions.explain: "Yellowstone National Park in the western United States was the world’s first national park" гэж эхэнд нь бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What causes the geysers to shoot hot water out of the ground?
options: Hot liquid rock under the park
questions.explain: "The pressure and heat cause geysers to shoot hot water out of the ground" гэж бичсэн. Энэ даралт, халуун нь газар доорх "a lake of hot liquid rock"-оос үүсдэг.

questions.prompt: Why is the geyser called "Old Faithful"?
options: It is the oldest geyser on Earth
It is the tallest geyser in the park
questions.explain: "it erupts about every 90 minutes" гэж бичсэн. Тогтмол, найдвартай оргилдог болохоор "faithful" (үнэнч) гэж нэрлэсэн.
